name: DJI Matrice 4D Series 240W Charging Hub (Chinese: Matrice 4D 系列 240W 充电管家), model CHX230-240

files.what: Official user guide v1.0 (multilingual). Page 1 has a labelled line drawing: 1 status LED, 2 mode switch, 3 power port, 4 three battery ports, 5 USB-C assistant port; and the hub wired to the DJI 240W Power Adapter via SDC.

search_log: Checked: enterprise.dji.com/dock-3/downloads (only 3D model there is the aircraft), DJI store product pages (global, CN), RoboMaster CMS/announcements/wiki (no hub page), web search for STEP/STL/GrabCAD. No official or credible public CAD found.
license: n/a (no CAD). Docs and photos are DJI material.

dims_mm.official: DJI publishes no dimensions or weight for this hub (store and spec pages checked).
dims_mm.retailer_unverified: 305 x 103 x 41 (D x W x H), 200 g, packaged 340 g; Multitronic Oy listing (EAN 6937224106352, DJI part CP.EN.00000627.01). Product and package dimensions are listed as identical, so treat as packaging dimensions.
dims_mm.layout: From the UG drawing (p.1) and photos: a long, low light-grey bar with three raised battery-port pads in a row along its top. Each port mates with the battery's 9-contact female connector (9x 02_EA230_BATT_CON-F_CONTACT-18A on 2.5 mm pitch) (geometry: 02_EA230_BATT_CON-F_* in the matrice-4d-battery STEP; the mating male connector 01_EA230_BATT_CON-M_ASM is in the Battery Rack 2 STEP). Each battery lies flat, label up, with its cap end pushed onto a port and its body running across the bar. Right end face: status LED (1), mode switch (2), power/SDC port (3). Left end face: USB-C assistant port (5).
dims_mm.scaling_hint: Battery cross-section is known exactly from the battery STEP (95.99 across latches x 59.33 thick), so the store photos can be scaled from the seated batteries.

electrical.charging: 3 batteries in sequence; Standard (100%) / Ready-to-Fly (90%) modes
electrical.in_box: Charging Hub x1, SDC cable x1

colors.body: light grey matte plastic (same family grey as the battery and airframe)
colors.battery_ports: dark grey/black contact blocks in each bay
colors.sdc_cable: black cable; SDC plugs with orange connector bodies

notes: Identity: the team budget's "Matrice 4D Series 240W Charge Manager" is DJI's Matrice 4D Series 240W Charging Hub; DJI's Chinese docs call it 充电管家 ("charge manager"), and RoboMaster sells it as the 新充电管家 (RMB 170 reference). It needs the DJI 240W Power Adapter (part charger-240w); it cannot be powered over USB-C. ref.jpg shows the hub with three batteries seated (photos 66cdf5... and b33131... show it empty).
